facts.fact: The National Population Commission says digital birth registration on the E-CRVS VitalReg platform started on 1 July 2026 and is operational in all 36 states and the FCT, no longer on paper forms.
The National Population Commission says death registration also moved to the digital E-CRVS system from 1 July 2026, nationwide.
The NPC chairman says birth registration coverage stands at about 57 percent nationwide and death registration below 20 percent.
